description: S52 T2 (LM6): the memory board, filtered IN THE DAEMON. Every filter is optional and every set filter ANDs; the answer carries each row in full with its own Describe sentence — the daemon's own words for its provenance, quoted by every surface, never re-composed by the app. Retracted rows are absent unless includeRetracted is deliberately set; here it is not, and the one retracted row in this store does not appear.

learnings.body: the CGO shim header must match go-sqlite3's version
